required.quote: commencing with license renewal, reinstatement, or reactivation occurring on or after January 1, 2026, except as provided in subsections (3)(c), (4), and (5) of this section, the board shall not renew, reinstate, or reactivate a license of a physician unless the physician presents evidence that the physician has completed thirty CME credit hours within the compliance period

hours_per_period.quote: the board shall not renew, reinstate, or reactivate a license of a physician unless the physician presents evidence that the physician has completed thirty CME credit hours within the compliance period

period_years.quote: Compliance period" means the twenty-four-month period immediately preceding the renewal, reinstatement, or reactivation of a physician's license

topical_requirements.quote: As part of the CME requirement established pursuant to this section, in addition to CME programs covering topics selected by the physician, a physician's CME credit hours must include: (a) CME credit hours that comply with section 12-30-114 and related board rules; and (b) CME credit hours covering a topic specified by the board by rule pursuant to subsection (7)(b) of this section.

credential_type.quote: the board shall grant a license to practice medicine to an applicant only upon the basis of: The passing by the applicant of an examination approved by the board

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who practices or offers or attempts to practice medicine, practice as a physician assistant, or practice as an anesthesiologist assistant within this state without an active license issued under this article 240 is subject to penalties

title_protection.quote: Using the title "M.D.", "D.O.", "physician", "surgeon", or any word or abbreviation to indicate or induce others to believe that one is licensed to practice medicine in this state and engaged in the diagnosis or treatment of persons afflicted with disease; injury; or a behavioral, mental health, or substance use disorder

scope_protection.quote: Holding out one's self to the public within this state as being able to diagnose, treat, prescribe for, palliate, or prevent any human disease; ailment; pain; injury; deformity; physical condition; or behavioral, mental health, or substance use disorder, whether by the use of drugs, surgery, manipulation, electricity, telemedicine, the interpretation of tests, including primary diagnosis of pathology specimens, images, or photographs, or any physical, mechanical, or other means whatsoever

disciplinary_grounds.description: Resorting to fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for, securing, renewing, or seeking reinstatement of a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Resorting to fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for, securing, renewing, or seeking reinstatement of a license to practice medicine or a license to practice as a physician assistant or an anesthesiologist assistant in this state or any other state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of an offense of moral turpitude, a felony, or a crime that would constitute a violation of this article
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conviction of an offense of moral turpitude, a felony, or a crime that would constitute a violation of this article 240

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing any habit-forming drug or controlled substance other than in the course of legitimate professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing any habit-forming drug or any controlled substance as defined in section 18-18-102 (5) other than in the course of legitimate professional practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of alcohol, a habit-forming drug, or a controlled substance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of alcohol, a habit-forming drug, or a controlled substance as defined in section 18-18-102 (5)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting the practice of medicine by any person not licensed to practice medicine or whose license is suspended
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The aiding or abetting, in the practice of medicine, of any person not licensed to practice medicine as defined under this article 240 or of any person whose license to practice medicine is suspended

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine as partner, agent, or employee of unlicensed person or in improper business arrangement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing medicine as the partner, agent, or employee of, or in joint venture with, any person who does not hold a license to practice medicine within this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate any provision or term of this article or applicable provisions of other articles
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating, or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisting in or abetting the violation of or conspiring to violate any provision or term of this article 240 or an applicable provision of article 20 or 30 of this title 12

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the board of a physical illness, condition, or behavioral/mental health disorder that impacts ability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to notify the board, as required by section 12-30-108 (1), of a physical illness, physical condition, or behavioral, mental health, or substance use disorder that impacts the licensee's ability to perform a medical service with reasonable skill and safety to patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any act or omission that fails to meet generally accepted standards of medical practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any act or omission that fails to meet generally accepted standards of medical practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a sexual act with a patient during the course of patient care or within six months following termination of professional relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in a sexual act with a patient during the course of patient care or within six months immediately following the termination of the licensee's professional relationship with the patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal of attending physician to comply with terms of a patient's declaration or failure to transfer care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusal of an attending physician to comply with the terms of a declaration executed by a patient pursuant to the provisions of article 18 of title 15 and failure of the attending physician to transfer care of the patient to another physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of abuse of health insurance or advertising prohibited services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of abuse of health insurance pursuant to section 18-13-119; or Advertising through newspapers, magazines, circulars, direct mail, directories, radio, television, or otherwise that the licensee will perform any act prohibited by section 18-13-119 (3)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any valid board order or any rule promulgated by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any valid board order or any rule promulgated by the board in conformance with law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dispensing, injecting, or prescribing anabolic steroids for hormonal manipulation without medical necessity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dispensing, injecting, or prescribing an anabolic steroid, as defined in section 18-18-102 (3), for the purpose of the hormonal manipulation that is intended to increase muscle mass, strength, or weight without a medical necessity to do so or for the intended purpose of improving performance in any form of exercise, sport, or game

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, distributing, or giving controlled substances to family members or oneself except on emergency basis
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, distributing, or giving to a family member or to oneself except on an emergency basis any controlled substance as defined in section 18-18-204 or as contained in schedule II of 21 U.S.C. sec. 812

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the board within thirty days an adverse action taken by another licensing agency or peer review body
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board, within thirty days after an adverse action, that an adverse action has been taken against the licensee by another licensing agency in another state or country, a peer review body, a health-care institution, a professional or medical society or association, a governmental agency, a law enforcement agency, or a court

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report surrender of license or membership while under investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board, within thirty days, the surrender of a license or other authorization to practice medicine in another state or jurisdiction or the surrender of membership on any medical staff or in any medical or professional association or society while under investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to accurately answer the questionnaire accompanying the renewal form
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to accurately answer the questionnaire accompanying the renewal form as required pursuant to section 12-240-130 (2)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful and repeated ordering or performance of demonstrably unnecessary laboratory tests, studies, or treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful and repeated ordering or performance, without clinical justification, of demonstrably unnecessary laboratory tests or studies; the administration, without clinical justification, of treatment that is demonstrably unnecessary

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying or repeatedly making incorrect essential entries on patient records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Falsifying or repeatedly making incorrect essential entries or repeatedly failing to make essential entries on patient records

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing a fraudulent insurance act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing a fraudulent insurance act, as defined in section 10-1-128

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to establish and continuously maintain financial responsibility
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to establish and continuously maintain financial responsibility, as required in section 13-64-301

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to respond in an honest, materially responsive, and timely manner to a complaint
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to respond in an honest, materially responsive, and timely manner to a complaint issued pursuant to section 12-240-125 (4)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising in a manner that is misleading, deceptive, or false
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising in a manner that is misleading, deceptive, or false

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any act or omission in the practice of telemedicine that fails to meet generally accepted standards of medical practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any act or omission in the practice of telemedicine that fails to meet generally accepted standards of medical practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering into or continuing in a mentorship relationship with an advanced practice registered nurse or certified midwife that fails to meet generally acceptable standards of medical practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entering into or continuing in a mentorship relationship with an advanced practice registered nurse or a certified midwife pursuant to sections 12-240-108 and 12-255-112 (4) that fails to meet generally acceptable standards of medical practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with requirements relating to medical marijuana recommendations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of section 14 of article XVIII of the state constitution, section 25-1.5-106, or the rules promulgated by the state health agency pursuant to section 25-1.5-106 (3)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conversion therapy with a patient who is under eighteen years of age
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in conversion therapy with a patient who is under eighteen years of age

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension of license as a result of a formal charge for a crime that is a continuing threat to patient safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any suspension of a license pursuant to section 24-4-104 (4) as a result of a formal charge for a crime pursuant to title 18, or that under federal law or the law of another state would constitute a crime under title 18, where the board finds the crime is a continuing threat to patient safety

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conviction of an offense under section 18-13-131 (sexual exploitation)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conviction of an offense under section 18-13-131

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeated or willful failure without reasonable cause to comply with requirements for medical certification of death
disciplinary_grounds.quote: On and after March 1, 2024, repeated or willful failure without reasonable cause to comply with the requirements of completing a medical certification for a certificate of death in accordance with any applicable deadline set forth in section 25-2-110

disciplinary_grounds.description: Repeated or willful failure without reasonable cause to comply with continuing medical education requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing, without reasonable cause, to comply with the continuing medical education requirement established in section 12-240-130.5 or to provide the required evidence of completion of continuing medical education credit hours in response to an audit by the board

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe and dispense medications, including controlled substances, subject to limitations on opioids and benzodiazepines
drug_authority.quote: Suggesting, recommending, prescribing, or administering any form of treatment, operation, or healing for the intended palliation, relief, or cure of a person's physical disease; ailment; injury; condition; or behavioral, mental health, or substance use disorder

license_status_types.quote: Any licensee pursuant to section 12-240-117 may apply to the board to be transferred to an inactive status. The application shall be in the form and manner designated by the board. The board may grant inactive status by issuing an inactive license

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: International medical graduates must complete one year of postgraduate clinical training approved by the board. If the international medical school is not an approved medical college, the applicant is eligible for licensure at the board's discretion if they meet all other requirements and hold current specialty board certification from the American Board of Medical Specialties or American Osteopathic Association
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: For international medical graduates, the board shall require one year of postgraduate clinical training approved by the board. An applicant whose international medical school is not an approved medical college is eligible for licensure at the discretion of the board if the applicant meets all other requirements for licensure and holds specialty board certification, current at the time of application for licensure, conferred by a regular member board of the American Board of Medical Specialties or the American Osteopathic Association

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Has completed either an approved internship of at least one year or at least one year of postgraduate training approved by the board

pain_management_education_required.quote: a physician shall complete CME credit hours in topics specified pursuant to subsection (6) of this section... CME credit hours that comply with section 12-30-114 and related board rules

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: A prescriber shall not prescribe more than a seven-day supply of an opioid to a patient who has not obtained an opioid prescription from that prescriber within the last twelve months and may exercise discretion to include a second fill for a seven-day supply. Exceptions apply for chronic pain, cancer-related pain, post-surgical pain expected to last more than fourteen days, and palliative/hospice care
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: A prescriber shall not prescribe more than a seven-day supply of an opioid to a patient who has not obtained an opioid prescription from that prescriber within the last twelve months and may exercise discretion to include a second fill for a seven-day supply. The limits on initial prescribing do not apply if, in the judgment of the prescriber, the patient: Has chronic pain that typically lasts longer than ninety days or past the time of normal healing, as determined by the prescriber, or following transfer of care from another prescriber who practices the same profession and who prescribed an opioid to the patient; Has been diagnosed with cancer and is experiencing cancer-related pain; Is experiencing post-surgical pain that, because of the nature of the procedure, is expected to last more than fourteen days; or Is undergoing palliative care or hospice care

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Each prescriber licensed in this state who holds a current registration issued by the federal drug enforcement administration shall register and maintain a user account as specified in section 12-280-403

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Physicians may deliver telemedicine services in compliance with HIPAA. Telemedicine is defined as the delivery of medical services through technologies including information, electronic, and communication technologies, remote monitoring technologies, and store-and-forward transfers, to facilitate assessment, diagnosis, consultation, or treatment of a patient at an originating site while the provider is at a distant site
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: Telemedicine" means the delivery of medical services through technologies that are used in a manner that is compliant with the federal "Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996", Pub.L. 104-191, as amended, including information, electronic, and communication technologies, remote monitoring technologies, and store-and-forward transfers, to facilitate the assessment, diagnosis, consultation, or treatment of a patient while the patient is located at an originating site and the person who provides the services is located at a distant site

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: To facilitate the licensure of a physician under the "Interstate Medical Licensure Compact Act", part 36 of article 60 of title 24, the board shall obtain a set of fingerprints from an applicant for licensure under the compact

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician assistant may not provide care unless the physician assistant has entered into a collaborative agreement with a physician licensed in good standing pursuant to this article 240 or article 290 of this title 12 or a physician group. With a collaborative agreement in place, a physician assistant licensed by the board pursuant to section 12-240-113 may perform acts within the physician assistant's education, experience, and competency that constitute the practice of medicine

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: A physician assistant with a collaborative agreement may prescribe and dispense medication, including controlled substances, to the extent and in the manner authorized by rules promulgated by the board
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: With a collaborative agreement in place, a physician assistant licensed by the board pursuant to section 12-240-113 may perform acts within the physician assistant's education, experience, and competency that constitute the practice of medicine and acts that physicians are authorized by law to perform to the extent and in the manner authorized by rules promulgated by the board, including prescribing and dispensing medication, including controlled substances

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Any final judgment against, settlement entered into by, or arbitration award paid on behalf of the applicant on or after September 1, 1990, for malpractice

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Any final action that results in an involuntary limitation or probationary status on, or a reduction, nonrenewal, denial, revocation, or suspension of, the applicant's medical staff membership or clinical privileges at any hospital or health-care facility occurring on or after September 1, 1990

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: If the board has reasonable cause to believe that a licensee is unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety to patients because of a condition described in section 12-240-121 (1)(e) or (1)(i), it may require the licensee to submit to mental or physical examinations by physicians designated by the board. If a licensee fails to submit to the mental or physical examinations, the board may suspend the license until the required examinations are conducted.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: If the board has reasonable cause to believe that a licensee is unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety to patients because of a condition described in section 12-240-121 (1)(e) or (1)(i), it may require the licensee to submit to mental or physical examinations by physicians designated by the board
